_source.document: ST/SG/AC.10/30/Rev.4 — Globally Harmonized System of Classification and Labelling of Chemicals (GHS), fourth revised edition, United Nations, New York and Geneva, 2011, annex 3
_source.why_rev4: GB 30000.2~29-2013 follow GHS Rev.4; the Chinese H/P texts in hazard_statements.json / precaution_statements.json are that edition's statements, so their English counterparts come from the same edition.

cross_check.note: rev10: same = identical text in Rev.10; removed = not listed in Rev.10 (deleted or merged into another combination in a later revision, e.g. P335+P334 into P302+P335+P334).

_source.copyright: © United Nations. Statement texts quoted verbatim from the GHS for labelling and safety data sheets, their intended use.
_source.scope: Only codes the CLP dataset (hpstatements_en.json) does not cover; CLP texts take precedence where both exist.

not_covered.H361E: not a GHS code (the Chinese text 怀疑对胎儿造成伤害 corresponds to CLP H361d); left without English text

H305.text: May be harmful if swallowed and enters airways

H313.text: May be harmful in contact with skin

H303+H313.text: May be harmful if swallowed or in contact with skin

H303+H333.text: May be harmful if swallowed or if inhaled

H313+H333.text: May be harmful in contact with skin or if inhaled

H303+H313+H333.text: May be harmful if swallowed, in contact with skin or if inhaled

P221.text: Take any precaution to avoid mixing with combustibles/...

P281.text: Use personal protective equipment as required.

P304+P312.text: IF INHALED: Call a POISON CENTER/doctor/…/if you feel unwell.

P335+P334.text: Brush off loose particles from skin. Immerse in cool water/wrap in wet bandages.

P370+P380.text: In case of fire: Evacuate area.
